champions.effect: Becomes invisible/untargetable to enemy troops and buildings for ~3.5 s (sources: 3-3.5 s) while attacking with ~+180-200% attack speed. Single-use since Aug 2026 (was 11 s cooldown). Aug 26 2026: damage 225->232.

Chains dashes between nearby enemies (up to ~10 targets, each dash deals dash damage, untargetable while dashing); moves faster when no enemies around. Dash range 5.5->5 tiles (Feb/Oct 2026 nerfs). Single-use since Aug 2026 (was 8 s cooldown).

Collects a soul for every troop that dies within 3.5 tiles (4->3.5 Oct 2025); ability spawns 6 (min) to 20 (max) Skeletons at his level. Soul bar resets if a duplicate is placed (Oct 2025). Single-use since Aug 2026 (was 20 s cooldown).

Drill damage ramps through 3 stages (stage switch every 2 s; base 43 dmg at L11 after Aug 2026, two-shots Skeletons). Ability: tunnels to the opposite lane and leaves a bomb that explodes after 1 s, hitting air+ground with 1.8-tile knockback. Knockback-immune. Single-use since Aug 2026 (was 13 s cooldown).

For ~4 s reflects incoming projectiles back at attackers, reduces damage taken by ~80% (one Nov 2026 guide says 65%), immune to knockback and Tornado pull. Activation time 0.93->0.7 s (Oct 2026). Melee 3-hit combo whose third hit knocks back (unverified). Single-use since Aug 2026 (was 17 s cooldown).

Ranged attacker whose hit speed ramps 1.2 s -> 0.4 s on consecutive shots (keeps the ramp briefly while moving). Ability summons Guardienne (~1800 HP, 232 dmg after Aug 2026; 400 charge dmg) who charges in, knocking enemies back 2 tiles; targets air+ground. Single-use since Aug 2026 (was 30 s cooldown).

Two units: Monster (tank, targets buildings) + Doctor (ranged, air+ground, 135 dmg after Aug 2026). Ability links Doctor and Monster for 4 s (5->4 Oct 2024); enemies within 2 tiles of the beam are shocked every 0.5 s (~188 dps after Aug 2026, reduced tower damage). Single-use since Aug 2026 (was 17 s cooldown).

Dashes (double damage, untargetable) at targets 3.5-6 tiles away. Ability: throws a grenade, turns invisible, teleports back ~6 tiles and dashes again. Holds up to 2 charges with a 3 s cooldown between uses (Jul 2025 rework); the ONLY champion/hero ability still reusable after the Aug 2026 single-use change. Jan 2026: damage and dash damage nerfed.

evolutions.effect: Rage-on-hit: every hit landed/taken makes each Barbarian faster and stronger for ~2 s; the anger stacks while fighting (also applies to Battle Ram Barbarians).
evolutions.stat_changes: No base stat change; 1 cycle (was 2 at launch Jun 2023).
evolutions.counters_change: Kill them before they stack: splash (Valkyrie, Bowler), knockback resets momentum; don't tank them with slow melee.

evolutions.effect: Each shot's main projectile and its 5 splinters leave small burning areas that deal damage over time (mini-poison patches).
evolutions.counters_change: Move swarm out of the sparks; Fireball/Arrows still kill her; pull with Tornado onto Giant Skeleton etc.

evolutions.effect: Deploys 4 Skeletons; every kill by an evolved Skeleton spawns another, up to a cap of 8 alive.
evolutions.counters_change: Use splash (Bomber, Zap, Log) so no kill chain starts; never feed them single low-HP units.

evolutions.effect: Cannon recoil: each shot emits a blast behind/around him that damages and knocks back nearby enemies.
evolutions.counters_change: Attack from range rather than melee swarm behind him; Inferno/Hunter from the side; knockback cancels charges (Prince).

evolutions.effect: Each shell also launches a Goblin that lands unharmed and attacks the nearest target.
evolutions.counters_change: Expect a Goblin at the tower every shot: keep a cheap swarm/Spirit; the building itself is still Earthquake/Fireball bait.

evolutions.effect: Takes heavily reduced damage while walking toward a target (shield-up stance); normal damage once he stops to attack.
evolutions.counters_change: Let him reach and stop (then burst him), use Inferno/pull; don't spell him while he walks.

evolutions.effect: Each Bat heals itself (~76 HP at L11, ~31% max HP) after every attack; can overheal past max HP.
evolutions.counters_change: One-shot them with Zap/Arrows/Snowball before they connect; splash troops; don't let them sit on a tank.

evolutions.effect: Power Shot: when a target is beyond normal range (5 to 6.5 tiles) they fire a stronger piercing arrow; normal arrows up close.
evolutions.stat_changes: +25% HP, +30% range; Power Shot dmg +18% (May patch); 2 cycles.
evolutions.counters_change: Close the distance fast or spell them (Fireball still kills); don't leave units sitting at 5-6.5 tiles.

evolutions.effect: When an evolved Recruit's shield breaks he charges (dash) at the nearest target for bonus damage.
evolutions.stat_changes: +11% HP, charge bonus damage 12%->6% (Nov 2023); 1 cycle (community; not officially confirmed).
evolutions.counters_change: Break shields with splash from range (Bowler/Valkyrie) so charges hit nothing; stun/knockback cancels the charge.

evolutions.effect: Ice Blast: the freeze also applies a second icy burst of area damage over time to affected targets.
evolutions.counters_change: Same as Ice Spirit: bait it, or accept the chip; avoid stacking swarm in its radius.

evolutions.effect: Her spin creates a tornado that pulls nearby ground enemies toward her for repeated 360-degree hits.
evolutions.counters_change: Fight her with air or from range; don't drop swarms near her; Inferno/Mini P.E.K.K.A one-on-one still trades fine.

evolutions.effect: Bouncy Bomb: each bomb bounces twice, exploding at each bounce (up to 3 explosions along its path).
evolutions.counters_change: Rush him with a fast unit or Log/Snowball; spread troops so bounces miss; don't pre-place swarm behind a tank.

evolutions.effect: Barrel Walkers: ride explosive barrels; when killed the barrel explodes and the Wall Breakers keep running with the dynamite for a second hit.
evolutions.stat_changes: Second-life runners have lower HP/dmg than stage 1; L6: 207 HP/367 area dmg, runner 103 HP/245 dmg; 2 cycles.
evolutions.counters_change: Need two answers (e.g. Log then a unit) or a building placed early; kill runners before they reach the tower.

evolutions.effect: Electro Pulse: emits a ~6-tile shockwave that damages (~192 at TS) and briefly stuns air+ground on emerging and on death; always at least two pulses (deploy + death, May patch).
evolutions.counters_change: Don't rely on Sparky/Inferno/charges near it (stun resets); kill it with spells (Earthquake) or out-range.

evolutions.effect: Triple Shock: zaps three times with growing radius (2.5->3->3.5 tiles) and growing damage (~192/384/576 at TS), stunning each time.
evolutions.counters_change: Treat it like a mini-Lightning for swarms: don't stack Skeleton Army/Goblin Gang; it also hard-resets Inferno/Sparky.

evolutions.effect: Sack-trick: below 50% HP he periodically drops extra Spear Goblins 2.5 tiles behind him (spawn speed nerfed Sep 2025).
evolutions.counters_change: Kill him from the front quickly with DPS; splash behind him to clear spawned Spear Goblins; Fisherman pull.

evolutions.effect: Whack-A-Drill: the drill resurfaces at 66% and 33% HP, each time leaving an extra Goblin; still spawns a Goblin every ~3 s and 2 more on death.
evolutions.counters_change: Place splash (Valkyrie/Bomb Tower) on the drill immediately; count on 2 extra Goblins before it dies.

evolutions.effect: Decoy Barrel: throws a second decoy barrel; both look identical in flight and only one releases Goblins.
evolutions.counters_change: Wait for landing before spelling, or use a wide spell (Arrows) that covers both; keep a cheap unit for the real one.

evolutions.effect: Cage Pull: ground troops within 3 tiles are pulled into the cage and trapped (cannot attack) until it breaks; releases a stronger Brawler.
evolutions.counters_change: Attack it with air or ranged units; don't send single melee win-cons (Hog) near it; Lightning/Earthquake it.

evolutions.effect: Fire Shield: spawns with a shield (~371 shield HP at max level); while active he pushes back nearby enemies; when it breaks it explodes (~231 area damage) killing swarms.
evolutions.stat_changes: 1 cycle; shield is extra effective HP.
evolutions.counters_change: Break the shield from range/with a spell first, then dive with Miner/Bandit; don't send Bats/Minions in.

evolutions.effect: Healing Blade: heals on every kill (~3.5-15% of max HP depending on victim), can overheal up to +50%.
evolutions.counters_change: Don't feed her swarms; counter with Inferno Tower/Dragon or kite with buildings; swarm only to distract, not to fight.

evolutions.effect: Mega Uppercut: his melee hit launches ground troops 4 tiles toward the nearest enemy crown tower (knockback); since Aug 2026 only every other attack triggers it.
evolutions.counters_change: Keep defenders behind buildings so they aren't thrown into your tower; P.E.K.K.A/Inferno from the side; avoid stacking melee on him.

evolutions.effect: Long Shot: her first 3 shots are sniper bullets with ~30-tile straight-line range and +50% damage (cannot target Crown Towers); afterwards a normal Musketeer.
evolutions.counters_change: Don't leave support troops in her lane line; close distance or spell her (Fireball+Log) before the 3 shots.

evolutions.effect: Super Charge: after hitting a building it bounces back and charges again repeatedly (each hit ~572 charge dmg, ~212 pushback dmg) until its HP is gone; Barbarians then drop.
evolutions.counters_change: Stop it before it connects (building placement, Fisherman, Log/Snowball knockback); kill the ram, not just the Barbarians.

evolutions.effect: Two-stage barrel: after losing 25% HP it drops a first barrel of 7 Skeletons mid-path and keeps flying to drop the second on the tower.
evolutions.stat_changes: HP 532->665 (+25%); death damage 145 -> 2x256 (Apr 2026: 220->192 area dmg to troops); 2 cycles.
evolutions.counters_change: Need two swarm answers or splash near the tower; shoot it late (over your tower) or early (over the river), not mid-path.

evolutions.effect: Toxic Darts: each dart poisons the target area (1.5-tile radius) for 4 s, damaging nearby units and lingering on towers.
evolutions.counters_change: Kill him fast (Log/Arrows/Fireball); keep swarm away from his target; tower takes extra chip, so don't ignore him.

evolutions.effect: Rage Ghost: on death drops his Rage and a Ghost Lumberjack (~256 dmg after Apr buff) that keeps fighting as long as it stands inside any Rage area.
evolutions.stat_changes: Cycles 1->2 and ghost dmg 192->256 (Apr balance); base stats unchanged.
evolutions.counters_change: Pull or kill him away from your push/tower so the ghost's Rage zone is wasted; stun/knockback the ghost out of the Rage.

evolutions.effect: Beam Momentum: keeps its current beam stage when retargeting within ~9 s (stuns still reset) and gains a 4th beam stage.
evolutions.counters_change: Reset with stun/freeze (Zap, E-Wiz, Freeze) rather than distracting with a swarm; kill it with ranged anti-air.

evolutions.effect: Deploy Barrage: on placement fires 9 cannonballs that damage (2.5-tile effective radius) and knock back air AND ground units around it.
evolutions.counters_change: Don't pre-stack swarms where it will land; place win-cons after the barrage; it still dies to Earthquake/Fireball.

evolutions.effect: Snow Bowling: instead of knockback, enemies are trapped inside the snowball and rolled 4 tiles with it (5-tile diameter path).
evolutions.counters_change: Monk's protection ignores it; keep defenders out of its roll line; it displaces, so re-place after it lands.

evolutions.effect: Axe Smash: at close range his axe hit is much stronger, knocks enemies back and cancels charges (Prince, Battle Ram).
evolutions.counters_change: Engage from range or with air; don't charge into him with Prince/Ram; stun to interrupt.

evolutions.effect: Healing Bones: every allied Skeleton (not Clone/Skeleton King ones) dying nearby heals her ~109 HP (1 s soul travel).
evolutions.stat_changes: 1 cycle; stats identical to normal Witch.
evolutions.counters_change: Kill her directly with Fireball/Lightning or a dive (Miner) instead of grinding her Skeletons.

evolutions.effect: Net Gun: before his first shot he nets the nearest target, pinning it in place for 4 s (net breaks if the unit splits, e.g. Elixir Golem).
evolutions.counters_change: Bait the net with a cheap unit first; don't send a lone win-con into him; stun/kill him from range.

evolutions.effect: Infinite Bolts: chain lightning no longer stops at 3 targets; it keeps bouncing between enemies within ~3.5-4 tiles indefinitely.
evolutions.counters_change: Spread units out (>4 tiles) so chains stop; kill it with ranged anti-air (Musketeer, Hunter) rather than swarms.

evolutions.effect: Hot Spawns: while attacking, spawns Fire Spirits from its sides every 2.4 s (was 1.8 s at launch).
evolutions.counters_change: Kill it before it engages (it spawns only while attacking); Arrows/Fireball; avoid swarm support near it.

evolutions.effect: Friendly Drag: every attack also speeds up friendly troops (+50% -> +30% Dec 2025) and slows enemies (~30%) in a large area around it.
evolutions.stat_changes: 1 cycle (Supercell calls it a 1-cycle evolution); stats unchanged.
evolutions.counters_change: Kill it early with anti-air; its push gets faster, so pre-place defence; Tornado it away from its tank.

evolutions.effect: Flying Pigs: the hogs fly toward the nearest building, deal splash damage when they land, then behave like normal Royal Hogs.
evolutions.counters_change: Ground-only buildings/pulls (Tornado) miss them in flight; defend at the landing spot with splash; air-targeting units.

evolutions.effect: General Gerry: the army spawns with a commander; while he lives the Skeletons are invisible and indestructible; when he dies the whole army collapses.
evolutions.counters_change: Target/kill the General (splash still hits him); don't waste Zap/Log on the invisible Skeletons.

evolutions.effect: Ghost Souldiers: on appearing he summons 2 Souldiers (Skeleton HP, Royal Ghost damage, 1.8 s hit speed, also go invisible when idle) that vanish when he dies.
evolutions.stat_changes: Stats unchanged; cycle count not found (assumed 2). Released Oct 17 2025.
evolutions.counters_change: Kill the Ghost himself (splash while he attacks); Souldiers die to any splash; don't let them tag your tower unanswered.

evolutions.effect: Horde Immunity: each Minion becomes briefly invincible (and visually invisible) right after taking damage; splash hits trigger it on all at once.
evolutions.stat_changes: 1 cycle; Aug 2026 reduced its hit-speed slowdown. Released Apr 6 2026 (Season 82).
evolutions.counters_change: Wait out the immunity window before the second spell/hit; single big spell (Arrows) first, then clean-up; Inferno ramps are wasted.

evolutions.effect: Ice Arrows: her first shot and every third shot afterwards is an icy arrow that damages and slows all enemies hit; on death she drops an icy area that slows troops.
evolutions.stat_changes: 2 cycles (Supercell Season 84 blog); base stats unchanged. Released Jun 1 2026.
evolutions.counters_change: Kill her quickly with Log/Arrows/Miner; move the push off the ice patch; slow effect punishes charge units.

evolutions.effect: Rage Javelins: both Barbarians gain a ranged spear throw (3.5-5 tiles, ~5 s cooldown) that leaves a Rage trail buffing allies behind it, on top of the normal charge.
evolutions.stat_changes: 1 cycle (lowest in game); stats unchanged. Released Aug 3 2026 (Season 86).
evolutions.counters_change: Don't stand units in the spear line; kill them before the rage trail forms; swarm+knockback (Barb Barrel) still works.

evolutions.effect: Level Damper: every few seconds he emits an electric shockwave that de-levels nearby enemies by 1 level (on top of the normal reflect zap).
evolutions.stat_changes: Cycle count not confirmed (assumed 1); released Oct 5 2026 via Shocktober album.
evolutions.counters_change: Fight him from outside the shockwave/reflect radius (ranged/air units); Inferno Tower still works if not stunned; buildings to kite.

evolutions.effect: Angry Giant: plays as a normal Giant until he drops to about half HP, then becomes enraged and leaves a Rage trail that boosts friendly troops following him.
evolutions.stat_changes: Cycle count and exact thresholds not officially published (assumed 1); released Nov 2 2026 (Season 89).
evolutions.counters_change: Kill him fast once enraged or pull him away from his support (Tornado/Fisherman); Inferno; don't chip him to 50% and leave him.

evolutions.effect: Evolved Mirror copies the last card played as its EVOLVED form (if one exists) at +1 level, even if that card is not in an evolution slot; otherwise a normal +1-level copy.
evolutions.stat_changes: Still costs last card +1 elixir; must cycle as a normal Mirror first (assumed 1 cycle). Released Nov 2 2026, Shop from Nov 9.
evolutions.counters_change: Expect a surprise evolved copy after any card: hold the counter for the evo version of their best card.

heroes.ability: Triumphant Taunt (2 elixir): gains a shield and taunts nearby enemies to attack him (taunt window 0.7->0.1 s, Apr 2026). Same base stats as Knight.
Heroic Hurl (2 elixir): grabs the highest-HP enemy troop within ~2 tiles and throws it ~9 tiles into the other lane; landing damage and 2 s stun. Counts as 7 elixir total.
Breakfast Boost (1 elixir): eats pancakes to gain +1 level per meter filled (meters fill over time/when attacking), up to +5 levels, and heals (40%->30% Jan 2026).
Trusty Turret (3 elixir): spawns a short-range (5.5) auto-turret in front of her that hits air+ground for 10 s.
Fiery Flight (1 elixir): takes flight for 3.5 s (5 s at launch; Sep 2026 nerf), +50% move speed, unreachable by ground-only attacks, throws 0.5 s mini-tornadoes (now 2 per activation).
Snowstorm (2 elixir): emits pulses around him: slow, then (formerly knockback, removed Apr 2026), then a freeze of nearby enemies.

Banner Brigade (1 elixir): the last Goblin plants a banner (lasts 7 s); activating spawns 4 Goblins around it (respawn moved farther from towers Apr 2026). Seed's '1->2 cost' claim not supported by Supercell notes.
Wounding Warp (2 elixir): after 1 s teleports (infinite range) to the enemy troop with the lowest max HP and deals warp damage (373->399 Aug 2026; reduced tower damage).
Triple Threat (1->2 elixir Apr 2026): dashes back ~3 tiles leaving a decoy whose next shot is a triple piercing arrow volley (bonus damage no longer applies to the triple shot).
Rowdy Reroll (1 elixir): after the barrel breaks, the Barbarian can roll a second time (reroll range 4->3 tiles, May 2026).

Coffin Cadets (2 elixir; one site says 1): drops Skeletroopers (buffed Skeletons) that deal landing damage and fight on foot (Skeletrooper dmg 256->204, hit speed 0.9->1.1 s Jul 2026; further trim Sep 2026).
Destructive Dismount (3 elixir): summons a Rhino mount that charges through ground troops and keeps fighting as an independent troop; Dark Prince keeps his shield but loses his charge afterwards.
Stone Swish (2 elixir): plants his feet and launches 4 boulders over 7.3 s (9 s at launch) with 11.5-tile range and +30% hit speed; up to ~768 tower damage if all connect.

Regal Revival (6->5 elixir Jul 2026): the building rises as the Tomb Queen, a building-targeting win condition (4044->4224 HP, 320->422 dmg, sight 7 tiles after Aug 2026) that spawns Skeletons on death; continuous spawn removed Jul 2026.
Wild Whirlwind (3 elixir): dashes up to 5.5 tiles toward enemies and spins for 3.5 s dealing area damage in a 2.5-tile radius (ability dps 388->324 planned Dec 2026).
Savage Survival (3 elixir): for 4 s her HP cannot drop below 1, hit speed becomes 0.2 s and she moves Ultra Fast.

Frosty Fella (2 elixir): his next shot spawns a Sneaky Snowman that freezes enemies around it (freeze duration 7->5 s Sep 16 2026; freeze damage 89->46 Oct 2026, no longer kills Skeletons/Bats); refunds elixir if he dies before the projectile lands (Nov 2026, unverified).
Surging Strikes (2 elixir): fires twin beams at two nearby enemies for ~3 s, stunning each target every 0.5 s.

special_mechanics.detail: On death splits into 2 Golemites and deals area death damage (~= its hit damage); each Golemite also deals death damage. Golem L11 ~5120 HP (deckshop).
On death bursts into 6 Lava Pups (low HP, target anything, air).
Drops a bomb on death: 209->269 area damage to troops, tower damage 418->269 (May 2026, L11); HP 1413->1313.
Death nova deals small area damage (~84 at L11 per wiki table) and slows nearby enemies (~35%) for ~1 s; targets buildings only.
Splits Golem -> 2 Golemites -> 4 Blobs; opponent gains +1 (Golem), +0.5 per Golemite, +0.5 per Blob = 4 elixir total.
Carries 2 Spear Goblins in his sack who shoot from his back and drop out when he dies; targets buildings.
Flying building-targeter; when popped deals small death damage and drops ~7-8 Skeletons (evo: 7 per barrel).
Charges after ~3 tiles uninterrupted (2x damage, knockback-resistant); breaks on hit, spawning 2 Barbarians. Stun/knockback resets the charge.
Ram charges after ~3 tiles (2x building damage); the rider throws bolas that snare (immobilize) a troop for a few seconds; snare also stops Hog/Ram charges.
Charges after ~3 tiles of uninterrupted running for 2x damage (one report claims 1.5 tiles after a rework); charge cancelled by stun/knockback/retarget.
Shield absorbs damage before HP; charges after 3.5 tiles for 2x damage; 360-degree splash melee; charge lost on hit/stun.
Dashes at targets 3.5-6 tiles away for 2x damage; untargetable/invulnerable during the dash.
Dashes (2x damage) at 3.5-6 tiles; Getaway Grenade (1 elixir): invisibility + 6-tile teleport back + dash; 2 charges, 3 s cooldown; exempt from single-use rule.

Every ~3.5 s can parry one incoming ground melee hit, blocking it and reflecting 200% of it; spawns parry-ready. Hit speed 1.4->1.3 s and crown-tower damage reduction 75%->0% (Sep 8 2026); first hit 0.3->0.4 s (Aug 2026).
Invisible (untargetable) while not attacking; becomes visible when he attacks, re-cloaks ~1.5 s after stopping. Splash still hits him.
3 Skeletons each with a shield (~160 shield HP at an unstated level; ~199 at L11 per seed) that must be broken before HP; shield blocks one-shot kills.
6 Recruits deployed across both lanes, each with a shield (~240-318 shield HP by level) in front of ~705 HP (L14 figures).
Single-target beam, 0.4 s hit speed; damage ramps through stages to ~20x the starting hit (L8: 32->640 per hit, so L11 ~43->852). Any stun/freeze/retarget resets to stage 1.
Air beam with 3 damage stages reaching full (stage 3) damage at ~4 s; retarget or stun resets (evolution keeps stage for 9 s). Optimal stun timing: just before 4 s.
Drill ramps through 3 stages, switching stage every 2 s (base 43 dmg L11); Explosive Escape bomb (1 elixir) 1 s fuse, 1.8-tile knockback, air+ground.
Charges ~4 s between shots (hit speed 4 s; one source says 5); huge area blast; stun (Zap, E-Wiz, Zappies, E-Drag, Lightning) resets the charge; Ice Spirit/Freeze also reset.
Spawn zap on deploy (area damage + stun); each attack hits 2 targets with 0.5 s stun that resets charges/Inferno.
3 ranged units; each hit applies a 0.5 s stun (chain-stuns a single target, resets Inferno/Sparky).
Chain lightning bounces to up to 3 targets (evolution: unlimited within ~3.5-4 tiles), 0.5 s stun per hit.
Zap Pack: any enemy that damages him while within ~3 tiles (one source 2.5) is zapped back: damage + 0.5 s stun/reset. Reflection disabled while Frozen. Evo adds de-level shockwaves.
Kamikaze: chains to up to 9 targets (damage 99 x9 at L11 per wiki table), 0.5 s stun each; Spirits can no longer hit Crown Towers on their own (Aug 2026); HP 230->215.
Instant area damage + 0.5 s stun in 2.5-tile radius; resets Inferno, Sparky charge, Prince charge; kills Skeletons/Bats.
Strikes the 3 highest-HP enemies in a 3.5-tile radius (one per bolt), each with 0.5 s stun; resets Inferno/Sparky.
Hooks ground targets 3.5-7 tiles away (1.3 s wind-up): pulls troops to him or pulls himself to buildings; slows target ~30-35% for 1.5 s. Can pull Hog/Ram off a tower.
Pulls all troops (air+ground) toward its centre for ~1 s with light damage; activates King Tower if units are dragged into its range; groups swarms for splash.
Rolls a boulder (~4-tile range) that pierces along a line, damaging and knocking back every ground unit in its path; cancels charges.
Rolls ~10-11 tiles, ground only, damages and knocks back everything in its path (cancels charges); kills Skeletons/Goblins; cannot hit air.
Rolls ~5 tiles (hero version 4.5) over ground units with knockback, then spawns a Barbarian; range too short to hit Crown Towers from the bridge.
Area damage, knockback and ~35% slow for 2.5 s on air+ground; evolution instead rolls trapped enemies 4 tiles.
Drops after a ~3 s deploy delay: area damage + knockback to air and ground, then spawns one Royal Recruit (with shield).
Freezes enemy troops and buildings in a 3-tile radius for 4 s and deals small instant damage; Inferno/Sparky reset; Electro Giant's reflect disabled while frozen.
+35% movement and attack speed to friendly troops/buildings in the area for ~4.5 s (5.5->4.5 Aug 2025; Lumberjack's own rage stays 5.5 s).
Copies every friendly troop in a 3-tile radius as a 1-HP clone with full damage (cannot clone buildings); clones push originals aside and die to any splash.
Replays your previous card at +1 elixir cost and +1 level (Mirror itself has no cost); evolved Mirror produces the evolved form.
Kamikaze: jumps to a target and heals friendly troops in the area (no damage); HP 230->215 Aug 2026; cannot target Crown Towers alone.
Heals herself and nearby allies on every hit (active pulse ~4/s while fighting) and passively (~2 pulses/s) after ~5 s idle; spawn heal ~200, per-hit heal ~100 (level unstated).
On death leaves an egg; if the egg survives a few seconds it re-hatches into a weaker Phoenix (egg HP +32% Mar 2026). Kill the egg to deny the rebirth.
Her shots curse enemies; cursed troops that die turn into allied Cursed Hogs (piglets) that run at buildings.
Spawns 2-3 Skeletons every ~7 s while alive (evo heals from their deaths); ranged splash attack.
Spawns Bats periodically (~5 s) while alive; releases Bats on death; melee ground attacker.
Spawns a Spear Goblin every 4 s for a 31 s lifetime (Dec 2021 rework) and 1 more on destruction.
Spawns Barbarians every 10 s for a 40 s lifetime (Dec 2021 rework) and 1 more Barbarian when destroyed (2022 rework details may differ).
Since Aug 2025 a 4-elixir ranged TROOP (hits air+ground) that spawns 1 Fire Spirit every ~5 s; evolution spawns extra Spirits every 2.4 s while attacking.
Spawns 2 Skeletons every 3.3 s for a 30 s lifetime and 3-4 Skeletons on death (Dec 2021 rework); Hero version raises the Tomb Queen.
Building with no attack; when destroyed (or expired) releases a Goblin Brawler (~1081 HP, evo 1189); evo pulls ground troops into the cage.
Can be placed anywhere; after burrowing it surfaces and spawns a Goblin every ~3 s while alive, plus 2 Goblins on destruction (evo adds pops at 66%/33%).
Placeable anywhere: spawns ~15 Skeletons one at a time over ~9-10 s in a 4-tile radius; skeletons target anything.
Thrown anywhere (flight ~1.1 s): releases 3 Goblins on landing (first-hit delay 0.4->0.3 s Oct 2026); evo adds a decoy barrel.
Placeable anywhere (burrows); deals reduced damage to Crown Towers (~30-35% less); good spell-tank.
2 kamikaze runners targeting buildings; each explodes for large area damage on contact (also small death damage when killed); evo keeps running after the barrel pops.
Throws bombs (ground splash); below 50% HP lights his fuse, charges the nearest building and explodes (~465 area damage at launch, since nerfed) - a death explosion, not a spawn.
Melee mini-tank (hits every ~0.9-1.2 s) that periodically fires a long-range rocket (every 5 s after Aug 2026, range 2.5-5 tiles, ~304 dmg at L11, hits air+ground).
3-tile, 6 s area spell: 35 dps to troops (10 to towers); cursed enemies that die become allied Goblins. Damage amplification removed (20%->0%) Sep 2 2025.
5-elixir (Aug 2026) area spell, 2.5-tile radius, strikes every 1.2 s: full damage to a lone unit (~696 total), ~42% each for 2-4 units, less for 5+.
Entangles the 3 highest-HP units in a 2.5-tile radius for 2.5 s (grounds air units so ground troops can hit them) while dealing damage over time (~134 dps after Sep 2025 nerf).

tower_troops.mechanic: Default tower troop; single-target arrows, hits air and ground; steady 136 dps.
tower_troops.how_to_play_against: Standard tower: tank with a mini-tank, spell-cycle; nothing special to exploit.

tower_troops.mechanic: Epic tower troop: one heavy cannonball every 2.4 s (~175 dps), hits air and ground; great vs single tanky units, poor vs swarms. Sep 2025 partially reverted a hit-speed buff.
tower_troops.how_to_play_against: Swarm it (Skeleton Army, Goblin Gang, Bats): each shot kills one unit; avoid lone mini-tanks.

tower_troops.mechanic: Legendary: stores up to 8 daggers and throws them at 0.5 s intervals (0.45->0.50 Aug 2025) for ~214 dps burst; when empty she recharges one dagger every 0.9 s (~76-90 dps sustained). Daggers recharge while idle.
tower_troops.how_to_play_against: Burn her 8 daggers with a cheap swarm/bait first, then push with the real threat; tanks beat her sustained dps.

tower_troops.mechanic: Legendary: slightly weaker than Tower Princess (~120 dps, dmg approx scaled from L15 158). Every 18 s (up to 30 s while attacking) throws a Pancake giving your highest-HP troop (>=20% HP, not the same troop twice in a row) +1 level. HP 2921->2703 Oct 2025.
tower_troops.how_to_play_against: Keep the tower busy (pancake timer slows while attacking); kill the levelled troop with spells; pressure early before pancakes stack.
